items.name: Kimchi Fried Rice (김치볶음밥)
items.description: Kimchi fried rice is a sizzling Korean comfort dish made by stir-frying tangy, spicy kimchi with rice, aromatics, and savory seasonings. It’s bold, hearty, and deeply satisfying—especially with a runny fried egg on top. Served with fried eggs, toasted sesame seeds, nori (dried seaweed).

items.name: Veggie Fried Rice (야채볶음밥)
items.description: Veggie fried rice is a vibrant, blend of corns, peas and carrots, fluffy rice, and savory seasonings. It’s light, flavorful, and satisfying—perfect as a wholesome meal or a versatile side. Served with fried eggs and roasted sesame seeds.

items.name: Tteokbokki (떡볶이)
items.description: Tteokbokki features chewy rice cakes coated in a bold, spicy-sweet gochujang sauce. It’s comforting, addictive, and guaranteed to light up your taste buds.

items.name: Rosé Tteokbokki (로제 떡볶이)
items.description: Rosé Tteokbokki blends the classic spicy-sweet flavors of traditional tteokbokki with a creamy, velvety sauce for an irresistibly rich twist.
